notes: #283's cheap gate: price what the round-82 depth-gate bands leave between their knees before anyone writes Stream-K; if no pinned split beats the gate beyond the null anywhere, the Laguna leg of Stream-K dies here
rationale: The depthgate (default on since round 82) picks 16 splits through scanned 16384 and 47 from 32768 up; its knees are exact fit points and FLOOR-TABLE's Stream-K writeup says the bands are 'exact only AT the knees and ragged between them' with the residual unmeasured. Depths chosen off-knee: 8192 (inside band 1), 24576 (BETWEEN the knees, the ragged zone), 98304 and 200704 (deep in band 2). Arms: the gate default twice (identical env dicts are the null pair, the specoff precedent), then the gate disabled with pinned NV_LAGUNA_M1_SPLITS in {24, 32, 47, 64}. Read: if some pinned split beats the gate at 24576 or deep beyond the measured null, the between-knees residual is real and Stream-K's Laguna leg has a quantified prize; if the gate matches the best pinned split everywhere, the bands are near-optimal and #283's Laguna justification collapses to the occupancy argument alone. laguna_flash_decode_gqa is 73.2% of steady deep GPU time (phase-validated), so kernel-level deltas surface ~0.7x in tok/s. 250W cells per #278.
